assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent game-mascot expression for a Japanese listening app, displayed at about 80 pixels.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the exact existing Kiku orange cat wearing purple over-ear headphones.
Primary request: Create the LIGHT intensity version of this exact mascot. Change only the eyes to gently awake small open oval eyes, with a relaxed friendly smile. Keep the same seated pose, resting front paws, curled tail, orange fur, pink inner ears, small purple nose, purple headphones and arch, thick dark purple outlines, gentle cel shading, proportions, and overall character identity. The pose should be calm and lightly attentive, clearly different from the original sleepy closed eyes, not excited.
Composition: one whole centered Kiku mascot on a square canvas, roughly the same framing as the reference, complete headphones, paws and tail with a small clear margin. Simple readable shapes for a small UI tile.
Background: genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the cat and inside the headphone arch.
Constraints: cat and headphones only; no text, labels, baked background, colored backdrop, checkerboard, shadow, extra objects, stars, sound rays, new accessories or additional cats. Preserve the original orange and purple palette; intensity colors will be supplied by the UI.
assets.visualReview: Inspected: the original resting cat/headphones identity with small open oval eyes and relaxed smile. Cat only, no text or backdrop, genuine transparent alpha.
assets.processing: Original generated PNG copied byte-for-byte; no pixel edits, resizing or alpha changes.
